evidence: Touches the wallet SQLite storage backend in `src/wallet/sqlite.cpp` and `src/wallet/sqlite.h`.
rationale: Encapsulating raw SQLite statement pointers in an RAII wrapper eliminates manual finalization boilerplate and reduces resource leak risks. While helpful for upcoming wallet database work such as storing transactions in a separate SQLite table (#33034), this is an internal refactoring that is reasonably deferrable.
